title: Warm Nutty Tunisian Cheese Tagine
description: A rich and indulgent Tunisian dish featuring a mixture of melted cheese, nuts, and spices, cooked to perfection in a bain-marie, with an ayurvedic-rajasic friendly twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the ras el hanout, salt, and black pepper.
In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the pine nuts to the saucepan and cook until lightly toasted, stirring frequently.
In a separate bowl, mix together the cheddar and mozzarella cheese.
Add the cheese mixture to the saucepan and stir until the cheese is melted and well combined with the pine nuts and spices.
Transfer the saucepan to a bain-marie and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove the saucepan from the bain-marie and stir in the chopped parsley.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
